versions.content: ModeDeclarationGroup . initialMode shall be assumed in the absence of ModeDeclarationGroup . modeUserErrorBehavior If the at- tribute ModeDeclarationGroup . modeUserErrorBehavior is not defined it shall be assumed that the ModeDeclarationGroup . initialMode becomes applicable in case of the mode user getting out of sync with a mode manager (because the parti- tion of the mode manager has been terminated).
